title: Prediction
description: An estimative statement found on a card (ADR-0010). Stores the source's original `phrase` verbatim and the mapped ICD 203 `band` (almost_no_chance 1-5 %, very_unlikely 5-20 %, unlikely 20-45 %, roughly_even 45-55 %, likely 55-80 %, very_likely 80-95 %, almost_certain 95-99 %). A number is stored only if the source stated one. The UI shows words. Mappings are made by a human or a deterministic lookup table; an agent's mapping is a proposal.

cardId.description: The card that contains the estimate.

phrase.description: The source's wording, verbatim, any language.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the phrase.

mappedBy.description: human, or lookup:<table> for a deterministic lookup table. Never an agent.

statedProbability.description: Only if the source itself stated a number, as a fraction.

allOf.description: A mapped band records who or what mapped it.

resolution.title: PredictionResolution
resolution.description: Recorded through the outcome loop by a human (ADR-0017).
